xmldoc.short_description: Saves workspace variables to a file selected from a dialog box.

param_input_item.param_description: Variable name, string array, or cell array of variable names. If omitted, the workspace is saved.

description.p: uisave asks for a destination file and saves variables from the caller workspace using the existing save behavior.

example_item.example_item_description: Preview a variable save dialog layout.
